About Me

I recently graduated with a degree in Electrical & Electronic Engineering and gained direct industry experience monitoring live Tier-1 enterprise infrastructure at Huawei. That experience taught me firsthand how critical network stability, observability, and incident response are.

Currently, I hold an AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner certification and am building a strong foundation in Linux systems administration, containerization with Docker, and CI/CD pipelines. My goal is to bridge the gap between legacy telecom infrastructure and modern cloud architectures.
